title: The Witch's Missing Multiplier
story: At the Rushlight night market, Clatterbroom the Hex Peddler has locked seven cages of enchanted songbirds with a riddle-lock. The lock opens only when someone names the secret number that, multiplied by 7, gives 91 — and the peddler swears no knight has ever managed it. Mr 6 rolls up a sleeve; he is a number himself, after all.
question: What number multiplied by 7 gives 91?
hint: Think of it as a division: 91 shared into 7 equal groups. Try 7 times 12 and see how close you get.
victory: Mr 6 said 'thirteen' and the riddle-lock sprang open; ninety-one songbirds burst out singing, and Clatterbroom fled the market with feathers in her hat.
imagePrompt: A crowded lantern-lit night market with a hunched hex peddler beside seven cages of glowing songbirds, a numeral-six knight studying a riddle-lock carved with numerals.
